cues.initial: Black; a raking cold light finds the flap of a cream envelope on a dark desk; a stick of red wax softening at the top of frame.
cues.action: One drop of wax falls in slow motion and lands on the flap on downbeat 1; the title fades up; frost creeps across the dark wood toward the envelope; the brass stamp descends.
cues.result: A glossy red pool on the flap, the stamp hovering out of focus above it, frost a hand's width from the paper.
cues.motif: the letter, hand-sealed; the cold creeping toward it

cues.initial: Close from the side at desk level: the brass stamp above the red pool.
cues.action: The stamp hits on the first kick; wax squeezes out at the rim; through the fill it holds, then lifts, a thread of wax snapping.
cues.result: The padlock sigil glistening in the red, glowing faintly green for a moment; the frost stopped just short of the paper.
cues.motif: the seal pressed: the padlock sigil

cues.lyric: You sent it on a Tuesday, twenty twenty-one
cues.initial: The whole sealed envelope on the desk in cold side light, the address in a hand.
cues.action: The camera pulls back and tilts; a postmark slams onto the corner on "Tuesday,".
cues.result: The envelope, sealed and postmarked TUE 2021-03-09.
cues.motif: the Tuesday letter, sealed and dated

cues.lyric: A little green padlock said the hard part was done
cues.initial: Extreme macro on the glass padlock set in the wax seal, dark.
cues.action: On "padlock" the shackle clicks home and the glass lights green; on "said" a tooltip "Connection secure" fades in; on "done" the envelope slides away, sent.
cues.result: A green trail where the letter was.

cues.lyric: I couldn't read a word of it, I didn't even try
cues.initial: A single glowing optical fibre across the dark; a brass-and-glass tap clamped on it; the sealed envelope riding into the prism.
cues.action: On "read" a reading lens swings over it and a warm lamp clicks on: through the backlit paper only a shimmering grain of ciphertext; on "try" the lamp clicks off.
cues.result: The envelope riding on along the fibre, unread.

cues.lyric: I made myself a copy and I put it on ice
cues.initial: The tap from below, a thin scan bar of white light in the prism.
cues.action: On "copy" the scan bar sweeps and a translucent twin peels off the envelope; it drifts down; on "ice" clear ice crystallises around it into a block.
cues.result: The copy suspended in a block of ice, its padlock a frosted, colourless twin.

cues.lyric: I don't have to break you
cues.initial: The intact ice block lowered on cables in a shaft of cold light, a steel cradle below.
cues.action: On "break" (the bass entrance) it settles into the cradle with a heavy weight; frost blooms along its base; ice dust puffs up.
cues.result: The block at rest, whole, the envelope sharp inside.
cues.motif: no force needed: the copy kept whole

cues.lyric: I only have to keep you
cues.initial: The cold aisle in darkness, drawer 0001 open at eye level.
cues.action: The cradle slides in; on "keep" the drawer shuts and its tag prints.
cues.result: Drawer 0001 shut, tag 0001 · TUE 2021-03-09 lit, amber lamp behind frost.

cues.initial: Inside the archive, facing the round vault door half open, cold light spilling in.
cues.action: The door swings shut over bar 16; in the fill seven bolts drive home, one per snare; frost blooms on the last.
cues.result: The vault door sealed and frosted.

cues.lyric: I'll wait for you, I've got the time
cues.initial: The full aisle in amber, symmetrical, drawers open.
cues.action: The camera dollies in a bar; drawers slam shut in a wave toward the vanishing point, a rank per beat.
cues.result: A deep aisle of shut frosted drawers, amber lamps behind the frost.

cues.initial: A clock face frozen in clear ice, gold light behind.
cues.action: The second hand drags and stops on "time"; the camera pushes in until the rim fills the frame.
cues.result: The stopped clock, its rim filling the frame height, ready to match the silo.

cues.lyric: Every byte you ever sent is mine
cues.initial: Straight down the vast silo of drawers, gold lamp rings into blue fog.
cues.action: Envelopes pour over the rim and spiral down, faster each beat; on "mine" every lamp flares gold, ring after ring.
cues.result: A vortex of envelopes funnelling into the deep, rings of gold.

cues.lyric: I'll see you sooner or later
cues.initial: Macro on drawer 0001's glass front, the ice block and envelope behind it.
cues.action: Frost grows over the glass from its edges, a step per beat; on "later" the last clear patch closes.
cues.result: A fully frosted pane, the amber lamp glowing behind it, the tag sharp.
cues.motif: goodbye until later: the frost closes over drawer 0001

cues.lyric: Harvest now, decrypt later
cues.initial: A wall of frosted glass lit gold from behind.
cues.action: The words cut through the frost as sung, HARVEST and LATER hardest; the light draws back in the dip.
cues.result: HARVEST NOW, DECRYPT LATER blazing gold through the frost.

cues.initial: The hook's last frame breaking into shards.
cues.action: The shards fly at the camera, revealing a cable split open: thousands of glowing fibres, every pulse split off at a row of brass taps.
cues.result: Fibres racing past, twins peeling off every pulse.

cues.initial: The silo from its rim.
cues.action: A torrent of envelopes pours over the edge into the shaft.
cues.result: The shaft swallowing the flood.

cues.initial: The tape-library arm between towering racks.
cues.action: It whips along its rail and slots a cartridge home on the last beat.
cues.result: The cartridge seated, lights rippling.

cues.initial: Low and close down a row of drawers.
cues.action: Drawers slam shut one after another toward the camera.
cues.result: A row of shut, frosted drawers.

cues.initial: A rack-end counter, the aisle beside it.
cues.action: The counter spins up.
cues.result: Five figures of drawers.

cues.initial: In the aisle.
cues.action: The camera rises up through the racks into a vast cold hall of thousands of aisles; the gauge lands on 9,400 PB.
cues.result: A hall to the horizon.

cues.lyric: They're stacking up the qubits, a few more every year
cues.initial: Macro on a small qubit chip on a dark bench under cold work light.
cues.action: On the beats from "stacking" larger chips slide in beneath it like a staircase, each grid lighting cyan, engraved 53 · 2019, 127 · 2021, 433 · 2022, 1,121 · 2023.
cues.result: A staircase of four lit chips.

cues.lyric: The experts said a decade, now the decade's nearly here
cues.initial: The cold archive from low down, darkness above.
cues.action: The gold refrigerator descends on its cables, its light sliding down the drawers; on "decade's" it stops with a heavy settle above the racks.
cues.result: The machine hanging over the archive, frost glinting gold.

cues.lyric: You changed all of your passwords, you think that sees you through
cues.initial: Behind, in focus, the live fibre with a stream of green-locked envelopes; in front, soft, the ice block.
cues.action: On "passwords," every live padlock re-locks a fresh green; on "sees" focus pulls forward to the copy.
cues.result: The copy's frosted padlock sharp and unchanged, the live stream green bokeh.
cues.motif: new locks above; the old copy unchanged

cues.lyric: But a blueprint or a birthday stays as true as true
cues.initial: Two ice blocks in a shaft of light.
cues.action: A blueprint lights in one on "blueprint", a birthday cake in the other on "birthday".
cues.result: Both frozen, tagged valid: forever.

cues.lyric: They handed you the new math
cues.initial: A shaft of light in the dark.
cues.action: A green lattice crystal grows and drifts toward the camera, held out; it snaps on "math".
cues.result: A perfect green crystal.

cues.lyric: You said you'd get around to that
cues.initial: The lattice.
cues.action: It folds into a cardboard crate; LATER slams on "that".
cues.result: A crate stamped LATER.

cues.initial: The crate sliding onto a warehouse shelf.
cues.action: The camera pulls back, faster with every kick of the roll.
cues.result: An endless warehouse of LATER crates.

cues.lyric: I'll wait for you, I've got the time
cues.initial: The gold refrigerator over the frosted racks.
cues.action: Its light swells with the bass; frost creeps up its rods by "time"; the camera arcs underneath to look up at the plates.
cues.result: Concentric gold plates from below.

cues.lyric: Every byte you ever sent is mine
cues.initial: Straight down the frosted shaft.
cues.action: Falling past rings of drawers; on "mine" the gold glow below resolves into the machine at the bottom.
cues.result: The machine blazing at the bottom of the silo.

cues.lyric: I'll see you sooner or later
cues.initial: Low on drawer 0001, frosted shut, the machine above out of focus.
cues.action: The camera settles; on "later" every frost crystal glints gold.
cues.result: Drawer 0001 under the gold glow.

cues.lyric: Harvest now, decrypt later
cues.initial: Macro on the chip at the bottom of the machine.
cues.action: On "decrypt" the qubits trace a key; on "later" it scatters.
cues.result: The grid, dim again.

cues.initial: The archive hall with the machine hanging in it under banks of work lights.
cues.action: A bank of lights goes out on each downbeat.
cues.result: The machine glowing alone in the dark.
cues.motif: the machine works through the night

cues.initial: Flat daylight: a kanban board, quarter columns, blind shadows.
cues.action: The board settles.
cues.result: An empty daylight board.

cues.lyric: Ticket opened, priority low
cues.initial: The board, Q3 2022 at the left.
cues.action: The PQC-114 card drops in; LOW stamps on "low".
cues.result: The card with its red LOW chip.

cues.lyric: Pushed to next quarter, four years in a row
cues.initial: A desk calendar in office daylight.
cues.action: A quarter page tears away on every 8th note; the card lands in Q3 2026 on "row".
cues.result: Moved 16×.

cues.initial: The card mid-shove.
cues.action: It lands in Q3 2026.
cues.result: Moved 16×.

cues.lyric: Somebody asked, "Who'd even store it?"
cues.initial: Close on the card.
cues.action: A comment types "who'd even store it?"; a thumbs-up pops on "store".
cues.result: The comment with 3 likes.

cues.lyric: Petabytes, darling. I adore it.
cues.initial: A hard cut on the loudest bar: the night side of the Earth.
cues.action: Gold archive veins across every continent; the camera leans in on "adore"; it accelerates toward the planet on the snare roll.
cues.result: The disc filling the frame.

cues.lyric: I waited for you, I had the time
cues.initial: The clock in ice in warm gold light.
cues.action: Water beads and runs; the ice slides off; the hands start on "time".
cues.result: Time running again.

cues.lyric: Every byte you ever sent is mine
cues.initial: The chip in gold light.
cues.action: A first row flares on the hit; every qubit blazes on "mine".
cues.result: Every qubit gold.

cues.lyric: The fridge hums low, the key falls out
cues.initial: Under the machine, gold light in vapour.
cues.action: On "hums" the rig shivers; the qubits gather into a gold key; on "falls" it drops.
cues.result: The key falling, turning.

cues.lyric: So that's what you were on about
cues.initial: The frosted padlock sigil on the copy's frozen seal.
cues.action: The key slides in and turns on "what"; on the hit the ice cleaves in two.
cues.result: The halves parting.

cues.lyric: I said sooner or later
cues.initial: The collector's desk; the reading lamp clicks on.
cues.action: The letter opens; the camera holds on one line: "No one else will ever read it."
cues.result: The line, read.

cues.lyric: Harvested then, decrypted now
cues.initial: The cold aisle, blue and frozen.
cues.action: In the near-silent bar everything stops; on "decrypted" a line of sunlight opens at the far end.
cues.result: A line of light.

cues.initial: The frozen aisle, a line of light at the end.
cues.action: On "now" sunlight rushes toward the camera, every drawer bursting open as it passes; pages lift with their broken red seals.
cues.result: An open, steaming aisle; pages hanging in the air.

cues.initial: Above the racks.
cues.action: Thousands of pages hang in the hall with their red seals; gold scan lines sweep them; the silo keeps pouring.
cues.result: The reading room.

cues.initial: The Earth's limb at dawn.
cues.action: Daylight sweeps across, the gold network burning on; the sun clears the limb on bar 85; the white recedes to the sun's disc.
cues.result: A point of light over the dark limb.

cues.lyric: Connection secure.
cues.initial: Ink-blue dark: a new letter, today's date, its padlock glowing green.
cues.action: On "secure." the tooltip opens; on the hit a pale copy peels off and drops away; the title fades up.
cues.result: Connection secure, and a copy taken.
